svg.title: Labelling and training workflow
svg.desc: The aspects came from labelling 338 discovery clusters. People labelled the first round, whose 299 test rows they kept, and the broker research test rows; an LLM rater labelled every round. FinBERT was further pretrained on the corpus, fine-tuned over three seeds on the LLM rater's labels, and tested against baselines on the sentences people labelled. The chosen model scores the whole corpus beside base FinBERT.

span.p:
Cluster labels drafted with an AI assistant:
10 aspects + other in config/aspects.yaml

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
First round: 1,277 sentences after cleaning,
labelled by two people;
978 train/dev, 299 test
preprocess.export_candidates, export_blind_test

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Sentiment kappa 0.93 between the two people
train.agreement

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Broker research, top-up and active-learning rounds;
100 broker research test rows labelled by people

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
An LLM rater labels every round, blind to the other labels:
kappa 0.79 on sentiment, 0.80 on aspect with people
train.rater_labels

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Test rows, kept out of training,
with people's labels:
299 first-round, 100 broker research

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Further pretraining on 42,822 corpus sentences,
labelled ones and near-copies left out
train.dapt

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fine-tune on 1,563 (sentence, aspect) pairs
with the LLM rater's labels, seeds 42, 1, 7
train.finetune

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Test on people's labels, three seeds averaged:
299 first-round rows, macro-F1 0.670 against 0.571;
100 broker research rows, 0.770 against 0.687
train.evaluate

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Baselines: base FinBERT,
VADER lexicon, TF-IDF + logistic regression
